Next: isolate the source of change

Repeat with a smaller time step for a spatial study. For an unbounded-domain approximation, enlarge the domain while preserving local resolution. Changing a physical wall instead defines a different model.

Next: test a research hypothesis

For a travelling front, measure its position and speed before measuring the disturbance. Separate phase drift from shape change, then compare transient growth across resolutions and observation windows.

Next: reproduce independently

Use the Studio's Python reference on a supported small grid. Agreement between two implementations of the same spatial scheme does not measure continuum error. Retain the original data and this bundle.

Evidence status: supplied numerical data. The viewer checks file structure and recomputes comparisons. It does not verify that the supplied fields solve the PDE, establish well-posedness or prove nonlinear stability.
